attacks.name: Tongue Lash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Poison|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§poison§Poison| special condition.

attacks.name: Spit Acid
steps: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

superPowers.name: Finders Keepers
superPowers.body: |*Action|: Choose an allied character within |!range| 2 of this character. Move 1 Asset or Civilian token the chosen character is holding to this character. This character is now holding that token. This character may not hold more tokens than the Crisis specifies.

superPowers.name: Hop
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Slippery
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, if that attack dealt |!damage|, this character may use this superpower. This character Advances |!range_medium|.

superPowers.name: Prehensile Tongue
superPowers.body: This character may Interact with objective tokens within |!range| 2 of it instead of the normal |!range| 1.
